research_question: Can exact ticker-year-form compatibility plus a unique-candidate abstention gate safely authorize one evidence passage for single-passage financial questions?

hypothesis.observed_phenomenon: Hard negatives frequently come from another company, period, or filing form, while the current fail-closed pipeline does not automatically authorize evidence.
hypothesis.possible_cause: Candidate evidence lacks a narrow provenance compatibility selector with an explicit ambiguity abstention gate.
hypothesis.expected_improvement: For single-passage plans, exact ticker, fiscal year, and document-form matching should leave one correct passage for many questions; the system should abstain whenever more than one compatible passage remains.
hypothesis.possible_side_effect: Dropping any provenance dimension or choosing among multiple compatible passages could confidently select a hard negative.
hypothesis.questions_that_should_improve: Single-passage questions whose candidate set has exactly one passage matching ticker, fiscal year, and document form.
hypothesis.questions_that_should_remain_unchanged: Two/multi-passage plans, missing metadata, zero compatible passages, or two or more compatible passages.

split_design.selection_key: sha256(seed + question text + canonical candidate passage hashes, exact provenance metadata, and gold/negative role); record ID excluded
split_design.company_holdout: Official FinRank ticker partitions are pairwise disjoint.
split_design.wording_holdout: Development and untouched normalized wording templates are disjoint.
split_design.metric_holdout: At least one FinRank topic has six or more untouched records and zero development records.
split_design.composition_holdout: At least one reasoning-type plus difficulty signature has six or more untouched records and zero development records.

evaluator.kind: FinRank gold passages and curated hard negatives with passage-level ticker/year/form metadata
